idealClientProfiles.label: Law Firm / Legal Services
idealClientProfiles.psychologyNotes: Prestige-driven. Partners expect to be impressed. Quality and craftsmanship signals matter enormously — they equate furniture quality with professional credibility. Never present budget options first.
idealClientProfiles.avoidMistakes: Never show volume pricing or compare to consumer brands. Always lead with GOJO Vol 2 or Fessenz Executive.

idealClientProfiles.label: Financial Services / Accounting
idealClientProfiles.psychologyNotes: ROI and certainty focused. CFO will scrutinise pricing — provide TCO justification (6-year warranty vs replacing at 2–3 years). CEO wants the office to project success. Emphasise ISO certifications and Australian standards.
idealClientProfiles.avoidMistakes: Don't quote without a full scope — financial services firms hate surprises. Always include contingency and clarify GST upfront.

idealClientProfiles.label: Tech Company / Startup / Scale-Up
idealClientProfiles.psychologyNotes: Brand-culture conscious. The office is a talent attraction tool — they want it to feel premium and innovative. Speed matters — they move fast and hate delays. Flexible and collaborative layouts preferred.
idealClientProfiles.avoidMistakes: Don't position as 'conservative corporate' — lead with ergonomic sit-stand, flexible layouts, and collaboration space design.

idealClientProfiles.label: Government / Education
idealClientProfiles.psychologyNotes: Process and compliance focused. Three-quote requirement is standard — being first sets reference price. ISO certifications are essential trust signals. Timeline certainty matters more than premium aesthetics.
idealClientProfiles.avoidMistakes: Always provide a detailed scope and timeline. Government procurement requires documentation — have spec sheets, certifications, and warranty documents ready.

idealClientProfiles.label: Engineering / Architecture / Design
idealClientProfiles.psychologyNotes: Aesthetically discerning — they will notice and critique design quality. Product design matters as much as function. Show catalogue imagery and material samples early. They appreciate GOJO Vol 2 craftsmanship.
idealClientProfiles.avoidMistakes: Never present generic product descriptions — use the heritage narrative for GOJO and design language for Fessenz. They buy story as much as product.

deprioritiseProfiles: No verifiable business name or ABN
Overseas companies with no Australian operations
